issues.t: Heat pump stops heating in cold weather (recall 22V-050)
issues.sym: Cabin heat and windshield defrost fade or stop in freezing weather, sometimes with a climate error message.
issues.why: A software fault could leave an expansion valve open, trapping refrigerant so the compressor shut down. Tesla fixed it with an over-the-air update. Heat pump hardware faults have also been reported.
issues.next: Confirm the car has the recall software update. If the windshield will not clear, do not drive until heating is restored.

issues.t: Water entering the rear cargo area
issues.sym: Wet carpet, standing water in the under-floor storage, or a musty smell in the back.
issues.why: Gaps around the liftgate lights and seals, along with panel fit problems, can let rain in. Tesla issued a service bulletin to reseal the liftgate lamps.
issues.next: Dry the area quickly to prevent mold and ask Tesla service about bulletin SB-23-10-003 for resealing.

issues.t: Front suspension creaks and rattles
issues.sym: Creaking over bumps, clicks when turning at low speed, a knock on rough roads, or a firm, jittery ride.
issues.why: Front upper control arm ball joints can wear early when moisture gets inside them, and bushings on the front links can tear.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected and worn arms or links replaced, then get an alignment. A loose steering feel or sharp clunks need checking right away.

issues.t: Loose front suspension bolts from the factory (recalls)
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front, changes in handling, or tire wear on one side.
issues.why: On some cars, bolts holding the front upper control arm or the front lateral links to the subframe were not tightened properly, so a part could come loose. Tesla recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check for open recalls 20V-709, 21V-835 and 22V-895 by VIN. If the front end clunks or steering feels odd, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.t: Suspension knuckle may crack (recall 21V-912)
issues.sym: Sudden clunk, the car pulling, or a wheel sitting at an odd angle.
issues.why: Front or rear suspension knuckles on some vehicles may fracture, letting suspension links come apart. Tesla recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN. Stop driving immediately if handling changes suddenly.

issues.t: Brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall 21V-387)
issues.sym: Scraping or grinding from a wheel, or a tire losing air.
issues.why: Bolts holding the brake caliper may not have been tightened, so the caliper can shift and rub the wheel rim. Tesla recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN. If you hear scraping from a wheel, stop driving and have it inspected.

issues.t: Seat belt fasteners may not be attached (recalls 21V-388, 21V-389)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. A belt anchor may look or feel loose.
issues.why: Fasteners for the front shoulder belts at the door pillar or the second-row belt retractors may not have been secured at the factory, so belts may not hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check for both open recalls by VIN and get them done promptly.

issues.t: Low-voltage 12V battery failure
issues.sym: The car will not wake, doors will not open with the phone or key card, or a low-voltage battery warning appears.
issues.why: The small battery that runs the car's electronics can wear out early on these model years.
issues.next: Replace the 12V battery soon after any warning, so the car does not shut down or lock you out.

issues.t: Doors will not open when the 12V battery is weak
issues.sym: Electric door buttons do nothing and passengers, including children in the back, cannot get out, often right after a low-battery warning.
issues.why: The doors use electronic latches that need 12V power. If that battery runs low the outside handles stop working. Federal regulators opened an investigation into this.
issues.next: Learn where the manual door releases are and show passengers. Replace a weak 12V battery right away and never leave children alone in the car.

issues.t: Phantom braking on driver-assist
issues.sym: Hard, unexpected braking on the highway while Autopilot or adaptive cruise is on, sometimes with a false collision warning.
issues.why: The driver-assist system can mistake shadows, overpasses or other traffic for a hazard. Federal regulators opened an investigation, and one software release was recalled for false emergency braking.
issues.next: Stay ready to take over, keep software up to date, and report events to Tesla and NHTSA.

issues.t: Camera cables swapped from the factory (recall 22V-317)
issues.sym: Autopilot or emergency braking behaves strangely, or driver-assist warnings appear.
issues.why: Two forward camera cables were connected to the wrong places on some cars, which confuses Autosteer and automatic emergency braking.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and do not rely on driver-assist features until it is fixed.

issues.t: Touchscreen can overheat and reboot while fast charging (recall 22V-296)
issues.sym: The center screen lags or restarts, and the backup camera or warning messages briefly disappear.
issues.why: The infotainment computer could overheat during fast charging with certain software. Tesla fixed it with an update.
issues.next: Confirm the recall software update is installed.

issues.t: Steering wheel bolt may be missing or loose (recall 23V-385)
issues.sym: The steering wheel feels loose or clunks on the column.
issues.why: On some cars the bolt holding the steering wheel to the column was not installed or tightened, so the wheel could come off.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN. If the wheel moves or clunks on the shaft, do not drive the car.

issues.t: Second-row seat back bolts may be loose (recall 23V-130)
issues.sym: A rear seat back may rattle or move more than it should.
issues.why: Bolts holding the second-row seat back frames may not have been tightened, which can weaken how the seat belts hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and have it fixed before carrying rear passengers regularly.

issues.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall 25V-092)
issues.sym: A steering warning appears and the steering suddenly becomes heavy, often after stopping and pulling away again.
issues.why: A circuit board in the electric power steering could be overstressed on some cars. Tesla addressed it with a software update.
issues.next: Confirm the recall update is installed. If steering assist is lost, pull over safely and do not continue until it is checked.

issues.t: Forward camera may be misaligned (recall 23V-489)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. Collision warnings, emergency braking or lane assist may not work when needed.
issues.why: The forward camera on some cars was not aimed correctly, which can quietly disable driver-assist safety features.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and do not depend on driver-assist until it is fixed.

issues.t: Battery crash disconnect may be faulty (recall 23V-434)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: The pyrotechnic device that cuts power from the high-voltage battery after a crash may be defective, raising shock and fire risk after a collision.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and have it repaired promptly.

issues.t: Backup camera goes black
issues.sym: The rear camera view is blank or freezes when shifting into reverse.
issues.why: A short on a computer board or a faulty software install could cut the camera feed on some cars. Tesla recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check for open recalls 25V-002 and 24V-035. Use mirrors and look back carefully until fixed.

issues.t: Backup camera image delayed (recall 26V-283)
issues.sym: The rearview picture appears late after shifting into reverse.
issues.why: A specific software version could slow the camera image. Tesla fixed it with an update.
issues.next: Confirm the latest software is installed and look behind you before reversing.

issues.t: Taillights may go out intermittently (recall 22V-844)
issues.sym: One or both taillights flicker or stay off, or a lighting alert appears.
issues.why: A software issue could cause the taillights to fail to light. Tesla fixed it over the air.
issues.next: Confirm the update is installed and check your taillights.

issues.t: Hood open warning may not appear (recall 24V-554)
issues.sym: No alert even though the front trunk lid is not fully latched.
issues.why: The latch switch may not detect that the hood has been opened, so an unlatched hood could fly up at speed.
issues.next: Confirm the recall update is done and always press the front trunk lid down firmly.

issues.t: Low tire pressure warning may not stay on (recall 24V-935)
issues.sym: The tire pressure light comes on, then goes off after a restart even though a tire is still low.
issues.why: A software issue kept the warning from staying lit between drives. Tesla fixed it over the air.
issues.next: Confirm the update is installed and check tire pressures by gauge if in doubt.

issues.t: Front seat recliner weld may fail (recall 24V-886)
issues.sym: The front seat back feels loose or moves unexpectedly.
issues.why: The weld joining the recliner to the seat back may be weak, so the seat may not hold the occupant in a crash.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and avoid using a loose seat until it is repaired.

issues.t: Battery contactor may fail and cut drive power (recall 25V-690)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive power, usually with a warning on the screen.
issues.why: Contactors in the high-voltage battery pack can fail on some cars, which shuts off propulsion.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN. If power is lost, get safely off the road and have the car towed in.

issues.t: Seat back fasteners may be loose (recall 25V-410)
issues.sym: A seat back creaks, rocks or feels loose.
issues.why: Fasteners holding the seat back to the seat base may not have been tightened properly, so the seat may not protect the occupant in a crash.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and have it repaired promptly.

issues.t: Front lateral link bolts may be under-tightened (recall 26V-558)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front or a change in handling.
issues.why: Fasteners holding a front suspension link to the subframe may not be tight, so the link could separate.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN. If the front end clunks or handling changes, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.t: Windshield washers may not spray (recall 25V-359)
issues.sym: Washer fluid does not reach the windshield when you use the washers.
issues.why: A hose connector can block the washer nozzles.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and avoid relying on the washers in dirty or snowy conditions until fixed.

issues.t: Horn may not sound (recall 25V-490)
issues.sym: Pressing the horn does nothing or works only sometimes.
issues.why: A ground wire terminal for the horn may not be secured.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and have it repaired.
